description: This is a shell script (`modify_system_img.sh`) designed to modify Android system image packages (target_files.zip). It updates security patch levels and version information within build.prop files and possibly adds VNDK version info for specific Android versions. The script handles extraction, modification, and re-packaging of system images and target files.
